## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The pull request adds `Cache.set` and raises the default TTL to 300 seconds. The new setter breaks case-insensitive key handling and should be fixed before merge.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — `set` stores keys without lowercasing them, while `get` always lowercases lookup keys; `c.set("ALPHA", 1)` followed by `c.get("ALPHA")` returns `None`. — Values written with uppercase or mixed-case keys become inaccessible, and differently cased writes cannot reliably update the same entry.

- Tests cover lowercase writes, case-insensitive reads, and expired entries.
